chunks: If you are killed in the cause of God or you die, the forgiveness and mercy of God are better than all that you amass.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of being killed or dying in the cause of God compared to worldly wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (AS) at Karbala, illustrating that the ultimate reward of divine mercy transcends the temporal losses of the faithful. It underscores the theological principle that spiritual proximity to God outweighs the accumulation of worldly wealth, a concept central to the Shia understanding of sacrifice and endurance.
